verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for POS software, since some POS systems can run on a merchant's own infrastructure, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Shopify POS only as an iOS/Android app that syncs with Shopify's hosted platform. Nothing shows a self-hostable deployment of the core product. UI extensions and Shopify CLI scaffolding are developer building blocks, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
